in person on Election Day, you’ll be asked to present a photo ID . Acceptable IDs include, for example: • A Michigan driver’s license or state-issued ID • A driver’s license or ID from another state • A U.S. passport (optional, not required) • Military ID with photo • Student ID with photo • Tribal photo ID card • Other government-issued photo ID The photo ID doesn’t need to include your address. If You Don’t Bring ID If you don’t have any acceptable photo ID or forget to bring it, you can still vote after signing a brief affidavit affirming you don’t have photo ID.
